title: Kraft NUTTER BUTTER Frozen Peanut Butter Pie
description: For the true peanut butter lover, this creamy pie has a peanut butter cookie crust and is filled with a blend of cream cheese, peanut butter and whipped topping.
ingredients: 24 NUTTER BUTTER Peanut Butter Sandwich Cookies, crushed
1 (8 ounce) package PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
1 (8 ounce) tub COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed, divided

steps.text: Combine cookie crumbs and butter in a bowl. Mix until evenly moistened; press into bottom and up side of a 9-inch pie plate.
Beat cream cheese, peanut butter, sugar and vanilla with and electric mixer until combined. Stir in 1-1/2 cups Cool Whip; spoon into crust.
Freeze until firm, about 4 hours. Remove from freezer 30 minutes before serving; let stand at room temperature to soften slightly. Top with remaining Cool Whip to serve.
